name: Covert Ops Pack
summary: In Stonetalon, Alliance agents use the Covert Ops Pack to disrupt Venture Company sites and take their plans. Its charges and schematics are aimed at the company’s work in Windshear Crag.

sections.title: Sabotage by Design
sections.body: The Covert Ops Pack brings charges and plans into Venture Company territory. Red and blue NG-5 explosives come with remote detonators, while Plan Alpha and Plan Beta guide the strikes. The charges target the lumber mill at Cragpool Lake and the eastern mine. When goblins rush to fight fires and inspect broken machinery, an infiltrator can pass through the confusion and take documents and schematics.

sections.title: A Confluence of Interests
sections.body: Night elf Sentinels and Alliance engineers in Stonetalon both gain from the Covert Ops Pack. Its blasts and stolen plans hinder clear-cutting and excavation on the sacred mountainside. The Venture Company engineering plans also reveal how goblin heavy machinery works. They show where the machines can fail and give Alliance engineers ideas to adapt for their own designs.

faq.q: What is inside the Covert Ops Pack?
faq.answer: The Covert Ops Pack holds red and blue NG-5 explosives with matching remote detonators, along with written instructions for Plan Alpha and Plan Beta.

faq.q: What is the tactical purpose of the explosives?
faq.answer: The explosives create loud distractions at Venture Company work sites. While security is drawn away, an operative can enter the lumber mill and mine unseen.

faq.q: What intelligence does this operation target?
faq.answer: The operation seeks Venture Company engineering plans from the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake, then executive letters kept in Windshear Mine at the crag’s eastern end.

faq.q: Who benefits from the materials recovered using this pack?
faq.answer: Night elf Sentinels and Alliance engineers both benefit. Sabotage hinders deforestation, while engineers study the schematics for weaknesses in Venture Company shredders and ideas to adapt for their own technology.

angles.text: For an engineer, the pack turns gnomish ingenuity against goblin industry. Its customized NG-5 charges help reveal how Venture Company machinery works.
As an Alliance member, you support the Sentinels’ struggle against commercial despoilment in the Stonetalon Mountains.
